rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Because the People of the Book persist in envy after the truth is clear, believers should forgive, turn away, and avoid quarrels or fighting for now.
rows.anchor: siz onları affedin {وَٱصْفَحُوا۟} dediklerine bakmayın, heyecana kapılıp da çekişmeye, dövüşmeye kalkmayın

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The deferred divine command may bring war, other calamities, and ultimately punishment in the afterlife for the envious opponents.
rows.anchor: Zamanı gelir Allah muharebe emreder, o zaman vazifenizi yaparsınız, zamanı gelir daha başka felâketlerini müşahede edersiniz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Prayer and almsgiving are two foundations of religion that prepare believers for every kind of advancement.
rows.anchor: bu iki binâ-yı din sizi her türlü terakkiyâta ihzar eder

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Any good deed done for oneself, including prayer, almsgiving, or other good, is found intact with God and rewarded on the Day of Account.
rows.anchor: onu Allah yanında eksiksiz bulur, hesab görüldüğü gün ecr ü sevâbını alırsınız

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He illustrates deferred reward with the Turkish saying that a good deed may be cast into the sea, since the Creator knows it even if the fish does not.
rows.anchor: İyiliği yap denize at, balık bilmezse Hâlık bilir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God sees and knows every deed, whether good or evil, and is fully informed of them all.
rows.anchor: Allah teâlâ hayr veya şer her ne amel yaparsanız her hâlde görür, bilir, hepsinden haberi vardır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Once an act has occurred it cannot be made not to have happened; even a momentary event remains forever an actual occurrence.
rows.anchor: vâki‘vâki‘dir, velev bir an olsun

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Even when a person says an act is forgotten, it remains in the spirit and can be recalled or recognized when reminded.
rows.anchor: O gizli imiş, onu evvelâ senin kalbin bilir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The rational soul itself is, for each person, an initial divine record of that person's deeds.
rows.anchor: senin rûhun, nefs-i nâtıkan, senin hakkında Cenâb-ı Allah’ın bir defteridir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Though unseen, angelic and other records preserve deeds, all inscribed in the Preserved Tablet and held by God.
rows.anchor: bütün bunlar aynen levh-i mahfûz-i ilâhîde mukayyeddir. Ve hepsi bizzat Allah’ın yedindedir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As the soul immediately knows when a thorn touches a finger, God knows precisely whatever touches a person's body, soul, or heart.
rows.anchor: Parmağına ufak bir diken dokunsa, senin rûhun ondan derhâl haberdar olur değil mi?

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A person will find good as good and evil as evil; the true measure of both remains in God's hand.
rows.anchor: her hâlde orada hayrı hayr, şerri de şer olarak bulacaksın, hayr u şerrin mîzânı da esasen Hakk’ın yedinde bulunduğunu

words: لَن يَدْخُلَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ إِلَّا مَن كَانَ هُودًا أَوْ نَصَٰرَىٰ
rows.speaker: Yahudîler ve Nasârâ
rows.claim: Jews claimed that only Jews enter Paradise, while Christians claimed that only Christians do.
rows.anchor: Yahudîler Yahudîlerden başkası, Nasârâ da Nasârâdan başkası cennete girmeyecek dediler

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Their claims imply that Jews of the Prophetic era spoke about Paradise and Hell.
rows.anchor: Demek ki asr-ı risâletteki Yahudîler, cennet ve cehennemden de bahsederlermiş

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The sectarian claims are empty wishes and fantasies; unsupported speech, desire, or mere imitation cannot establish a religious claim or yield faith's grace.
rows.anchor: lâkin sade ümniyye ve yalan mefkûre ile iş bitmez

rows.speaker: Ebû Ca‘fer
rows.claim: Abu Ja'far reads the word with an ungeminated yā; the sense is that they idly imagine and wish for this.
rows.anchor: أَمَانِيُّهُمْ’de “ya” şeddesiz olarak da okunur (Ebû Ca‘fer kıraati)

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The opposing, mutually inconsistent claims require proof; proof is what can bring people together on a true position, and neither side can supply it.
rows.anchor: hangi biriniz bu davanızda sâdıksanız burhânınızı getiriniz, görelim; zira insanları doğru bir noktada toplayacak olan şey burhandır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Paradise belongs neither exclusively to Jews nor Christians: whoever dedicates the self to God in full sincerity, cleansed of shirk and its signs, and recognizes one God has the promised reward.
rows.anchor: nefsini şirkten ve emâre-i şirkten temizleyerek kemâl-i ihlâs ile Allah’a verir, bir Allah tanır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The person also acts as a muhsin, conscious of being before God as if seeing Him, and performs deeds with a thoroughly pure heart.
rows.anchor: Allah’ı görüyormuş gibi kendini Allah huzurunda bilerek yaptığını her vechile temiz kalb ile güzel de yaparsa

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Such a person receives reward from the Lord and will have no future fear or grief in the afterlife.
rows.anchor: وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

words: مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These are the Muslims; this religion is Islam, and Paradise belongs to them. With God, religion consists in this Islam.
rows.anchor: Cennet bunlarındır. ‘İndallah din de bu İslâm’dan ibarettir

words: وَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The descriptions in 2:38 and 2:62 of people without fear or grief who receive reward refer to this same kind of believer.
rows.anchor: Bâlâda haklarında فَمَن تَبِعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا خَوْفٌ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا هُمْ يَحْزَنُونَ

words: مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The religion preached by Muhammad has this essence; it is truth, attested by God, reason, and transmitted evidence, rather than a wish or group fantasy.
rows.anchor: Muhammed aleyhisselâm’ın tebliğ ettiği dinin esâsı da budur. Ve bu hakikattir ki bir ümniyyeden ibaret değildir

words: مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Tawhid, sincerity, and ihsan are not products of whim; they are qualities formed by cleansing the heart of its desires.
rows.anchor: gönüllerin bir hevâsı değil, o hevâları silip temizlemekle yapılacak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Islam is a metaphorical face-cleanliness: purity of the person's outward and inward self.
rows.anchor: İslâm, Allah’a karşı yüz aklığı, alın temizliğidir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The face stands for the whole person by mentioning a part for the whole; using face rather than self signals that Islam is not merely inward.
rows.anchor: “vech”, zikr-i cüz irâde-i kül tarîkiyle nefs ve zâtdan mecazdır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: As the prostrating, noblest limb and representative of the body, the face can identify a whole person, and its depiction represents the whole body.
rows.anchor: secde uzvu olan vech a‘zanın eşrefi ve bütün vücûdun mümessili bulunan bir uzuvdur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Islam derives from the silm and salāmah root and can convey submission, obedience, keeping safe and unblemished, entering or emerging into safety, peaceful relations, and sincerity; surrender to God in faith and obedience encompasses these senses.
rows.anchor: “İslâm”, “silm” ü “selâmet” maddesinden if‘âl olduğu için, if‘âl bâbının muhtelif binâlarına göre

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ihsan means beautifying: performing an action that is good in itself and before God properly, adorning its intrinsic goodness with the goodness of its manner.
rows.anchor: vech-i lâyıkıyla gereği gibi yapıp o amelin hüsn-i zâtîsini

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A thing may be good in itself yet made ugly by the way it is done, so ihsan perfects both the deed and its performance.
rows.anchor: Zira birçok güzel şeyler vardır ki yapılırken çirkinleştirilir

rows.speaker: Resûlullah Efendimiz
rows.claim: In the famous hadith of faith, the Prophet explains ihsan as worshipping God as though one sees Him, and knowing He sees one if one does not see Him.
rows.anchor: Resûlullah Efendimiz meşhur iman hadîsinde ihsânı şöyle tefsir buyurmuştur

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Ihsan is the perfection of Islam; Islam's guiding summary is first purity, then beauty.
rows.anchor: Binâen‘aleyh ihsan, İslâm’ın kemâlindendir. Bunun için düstûr-i İslâm şöyle hulâsa edilebilir: Evvelâ temizlik, sâniyen güzellik

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The principle of purity and beauty applies throughout Islam, from its testimony of faith, invocation, ablution, and prayer to all its commands and prohibitions.
rows.anchor: İslâm’ın لاَ اِلٰهَ اِلاَّ اللّٰهّٰ kelime-i tevhîdinden, e‘ûzü besmelesinden, abdest ve namazından tut da bütün evâmir ü nevâhîsinde

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse neatly summarizes Islam and ihsan as having a clean face toward God and a good inner self.
rows.anchor: Allah’a yüzü temiz özü güzel

words: مَنْ أَسْلَمَ وَجْهَهُۥ لِلَّهِ وَهُوَ مُحْسِنٌۭ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The proper path to Paradise is Islam and ihsan, purity and beauty; the Jews and Christians who departed from it have no proof for their exclusive claims, and their own disputes disprove them.
rows.anchor: İşte cennete girmenin doğru yolu

words: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ لَيْسَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A reported occasion has Najran Christians visiting the Prophet while Medina's Jewish scholars were present; they disputed, and Rafi b. Huraymila denied Jesus and the Gospel, then a Najrani denied Moses' prophethood and the Torah, after which the verse was revealed.
rows.anchor: Rivayet olunuyor ki Necran ahâlisi Hıristiyanlarından bir heyet, sefaretle huzûr-i risâlete geldikleri zaman Medine’nin Yahudî ulemâsı da yanlarına gelmişlerdi

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The dispute is not an isolated incident but a general Jewish-Christian conflict in which each side denies the other's religion outright.
rows.anchor: bu münâza‘a ve münâkaza ferdî değil, ‘ale’l-‘umûm Yahudîlerle Nasârâ arasında cârî ve sârîdir

words: وَقَالَتِ ٱلْيَهُودُ لَيْسَتِ ٱلنَّصَٰرَىٰ عَلَىٰ شَىْءٍۢ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The verse mentions the Jews' rejection of Christianity; although Jews broadly reject Jesus and the Gospel, Christian rejection of Moses and the Torah is not general enough to report or universalize here.
rows.anchor: Âyet yalnız münâza‘anın ilk şıkkını beyan buyurmuş, diğerlerinin şâyân-ı zikr ü ta‘mîm olmadığını anlatmıştır

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: It is especially improper for readers of scripture, including those who read the same Torah, to repudiate one another; scripture prevents such fundamental contradiction and bears witness against their claims.
rows.anchor: kitap okuyanlara ve ‘ale’l-husûs aynı kitabı okuyanlara ise bu hâl yakışmaz

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The scriptures also contain glad tidings about Jesus and Muhammad, which further undercuts the disputants' denials.
rows.anchor: hem Hazret-i Îsâ ve hem Hazret-i Muhammed ‘aleyhimesselâm hakkında tebşîrâtı bile muhtevîdir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Jewish attacks on Christianity contradict their books, while Christian attacks on Judaism are even more excessive and contradict their own foundations.
rows.anchor: Yahudîlerin Nasrâniyete bu kadar hücumları kitaplarına muhalif bir ifrat, Nasârâ’nın Tevrat okuyup dururken Yahudîliğe bu kadar hücumları da ondan daha ziyade bir ifrat

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Both groups lie, are far from sincerity and ihsan, and falsely claim that Paradise is exclusively theirs.
rows.anchor: cennet bize mahsus demeleri de bu yalanlar cümlesindendir

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The passage warns believers not to imitate these groups by abandoning Islam and ihsan for a destructive dispute despite sharing a scripture.
rows.anchor: hepiniz bir kitap okurken İslâm ve ihsânı bırakarak böyle fena bir nizâ‘a düşmeyiniz

words: كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ignorant people without scripture are Arab polytheists, idolaters, and irreligious people who likewise claim that Judaism, Christianity, and revealed religions lack any basis.
rows.anchor: ilmi olmayan kitapsız câhiller, Arap müşrikleri, putperestler, dinsizler de tıpkı bunların söyledikleri gibi söylediler

words: كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The ignorant speak this way from lack of knowledge, whereas Jews and Christians know better and speak from selfish desire.
rows.anchor: Bir farkı varsa bunlar bilmediklerinden böyle söylüyorlar

words: كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Muslims should not wholesale-deny other religions; they should assess claims by reason and transmitted evidence, establish them with proof, speak with ihsan as before God, and tell the truth.
rows.anchor: diğer dinleri kökünden inkâr etmemeli, söylediklerini akl u nakle tatbik ve burhan ile isbat ederek

words: كَذَٰلِكَ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ مِثْلَ قَوْلِهِمْ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: He cites 16:125 and 29:46 as guidance to invite with wisdom and good exhortation and to debate the People of the Book only in the best manner.
rows.anchor: ٱدْعُ إِلَىٰ سَبِيلِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْحِكْمَةِ وَٱلْمَوْعِظَةِ ٱلْحَسَنَةِ وَجَٰدِلْهُم بِٱلَّتِى هِىَ أَحْسَنُ

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: These crooked methods cannot resolve worldly disputes or let humanity universally taste the delight of tawhid and God's favor.
rows.anchor: Yoksa Yehûd ve Nasârâ’nın vesâir cehelenin tuttukları bu eğri yollarla

words: فَٱللَّهُ يَحْكُمُ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُوا۟ فِيهِ يَخْتَلِفُونَ
rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: God will execute judgment on the disputants' disagreements at the Resurrection and decisively settle their conflicts.
rows.anchor: Cenâb-ı Allah bunların dünyada böyle ihtilâf etmekte bulundukları şeyler hakkında yarın yevm-i kıyâmette beynlerinde hükmünü verecek

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Earthly unjust rulings gained through sophistry, deceit, coercion, or domination are eventually annulled, even if issued by the League of Nations; God's court's judgments never change, and oppressors will face woe.
rows.anchor: Bu dünyada cerbeze ile, safsata ile, yalanla, şarlatanlıkla

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: The phrase means death has approached and shown its signs, during the illness of death.
rows.anchor: herhangi birinize ölüm hâzır olduğu, yani yaklaşıp emârelerini gösterdiği demde, maraz-ı mevt hengâmında

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Here khayr means property left after death, especially a substantial estate.
rows.anchor: eğer bir hayır terk ederse; ba‘de’l-mevt mal bırakacak, hatta çok bir mal bırakacak olursa

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: A bequest for parents and near relatives must follow what is recognized as fair, avoiding excess, deficiency, injustice, and harm that causes alienation or disappointment.
rows.anchor: mâruf vechile, yani ifrât u tefritten, tevahhuş ve inkisârı mûcib cevrden ‘ârî, adalet dairesinde vasiyet yapmak

rows.speaker: author
rows.claim: Carrying out this fair bequest is an obligatory right upon the God-fearing.
rows.anchor: müttakīler üzerine hakkan vâcib oldu
